recipes_results.title: Churma Laddu is the authentic sweet recipe from Rajasthan and Gujarat state in India. It is sweet prepared from jaggery, ghee (clarified butter), and coarsely ground whole wheat flour. Step by step process 1)Take whole wheat flour in a big mixing bowl and add oil. Mix both very well. 2)Add warm water, a little at a time, to make a tight and stiff dough. 3)Divide the dough into 8 parts and shape the dough in cylinders muthiya (dumplings). You can give any shape but it should not be too thick. 4)Now heat ghee/oil on low heat to fry the dumplings. 5)Fry the muthia till they are nice light brown. It will take about 5 to 7 minutes. Always fry them on a low flame. 6)Let them cool completely Then using hand first make small pieces. Now take them in a food processer or grinder and finely grind them. If Keep it aside. 7)In a pan, add jaggery/sugar powder and melt it over medium heat. 8)Add melted jaggery/sugar in churma mixture and mix very well with a spoon or spatula. Now add cardamom powder and nutmeg powder. Keep it aside. 9)Now take a couple of tablespoon mixtures and with your hand give a round shape to ladoo. 10)Take 2 tablespoon poppy seeds on a plate and roll all the ladoo.
